matrix_scope_definition: Model matrix projections, iHC linear mixing dots, and attention QK/SV contractions, under the existing reviewed precision convention. Scalar reductions, fast Hadamard butterflies, rotary transforms, quantization, selection and copies are excluded from this numerator; exclusion does not mean zero arithmetic.
scalar_convention: Source-level arithmetic convention, not executed-instruction count. Normalization counts each reduction addition and treats rsqrt as one semantic operation; compare/sort/convert and physical pipeline work remain separate.

limits: Applies only to the 45 selected captured events. Collector warnings/full-request capture coverage limitations remain unchanged.
No existing full-report work binding, event, timing or FLOP count is modified. matrix_scope_reviewed is deliberately separate from work_bound and byte/scalar completeness.
Nominal precision-weighted MFU is an algebraic roof ratio, not measured SM activity or a calibrated TileSight latency prediction.

New source files are checksum-pinned retained source; no live GPU or installed-source read was made in this CPU-only review. Symbol/shape matching and existing pinned model source provide operation classification.
Useful-byte estimates are not additive across operations and do not determine physical parent DRAM MBU.
